cadence_note: Four guides, one per week of the first month. Every guide is question-shaped and tied to a category that actually has a verified product in data/products.json. No search-volume, popularity or superiority claims are made anywhere: no keyword tool with first-party or licensed data was available to this session.

guides.title: Peel-and-stick wallpaper smoothing kit: what should you compare before you buy?
guides.short_title: What should you compare in a smoothing kit?
guides.dek: Four things that decide whether a kit earns its place in a drawer, checked against the Art3d kit linked from this site.
guides.intent: Reader is mid-project, has the vinyl or contact paper in a cart, and is deciding whether a tool kit is part of the order.
guides.next_step: Compare the tool list against what you already own, then check wall texture.

guides.title: Under-cabinet paper towel holder: how do you check the fit before ordering?
guides.short_title: How do you check an under-cabinet holder fits?
guides.dek: Adhesive or screws, roll width, cabinet overhang and clearance. Measure these five things before you trust a photo.
guides.intent: Reader is replacing a countertop holder or freeing counter space in a rental.
guides.next_step: Write down five measurements, then decide adhesive versus drilling.

guides.title: How many tiers does your cabinet actually need?
guides.short_title: How many tiers do you need?
guides.dek: A short measurement routine that stops you buying eight tiers for a cabinet that fits four, using the ORDORA 8-tier rack as the worked example.
guides.intent: Reader has pans stacked three deep and is considering a rack.
guides.next_step: Measure internal height, pan diameter and pan weight.

guides.title: What should you ask before any small under-cabinet upgrade?
guides.short_title: What should you ask before buying?
guides.dek: The six questions that cover adhesive failure, rental damage, clearance and whether storage is even your real problem.
guides.intent: Reader is browsing broadly and has not chosen a product type.
guides.next_step: Answer six questions, then pick a category rather than a product.
